breadcrumb.name: Sharjah Traffic Fines – How to Check and Pay

contentHtml:
Traffic safety in Sharjah is paramount. The stringent rules have been implemented by the authorities. So that the roads remain safe for everyone. Violations of these rules result in hefty fines. It also carries other serious penalties. You may face black points, vehicle confiscation, and even driving license suspension. Don’t ever dare to drive without a license. Driving a vehicle without a license in the UAE, Sharjah, can lead to a fine of AED 500. Be ready for four black points and a seven-day car impoundment.

In light of these significant penalties, drivers must stay on top of their traffic fines. It’s advisable to clear them promptly if they have ever been fined. This helps to avoid further complications. Fortunately, rent a car in Sharjah has made it incredibly easy. Now, residents of Sharjah can check and pay traffic fines online. Let’s take a deeper dive into the ways you can track your traffic fines. Know in detail how to pay them without any hassle.

How to Check Sharjah Traffic Fines Online

Staying informed about any fines issued is important when driving in Sharjah. Keeping track of these fines can eliminate the chances of further penalties/fines that come with overdue payments. Luckily, Sharjah offers several convenient methods to check fine status online.

The most common and reliable ways to check your traffic fines in Sharjah are:

1. Sharjah Police Official Website

Sharjah Police has set up an easy-to-navigate online portal. Through this platform, you can check your traffic fines quickly. Follow these simple steps:

  1. Visit the Sharjah Police traffic services page

  2. Click Traffic Fines Inquiry

  3. Select By Plate Number

  4. Enter:

  • Plate number
  • Plate type
  • Emirate (Sharjah)

5. Click Search

You will see:

  • Violation date
  • Fine amount
  • Black points
  • Payment status

2. Emirates Vehicle Gate (EVG) Website

The Emirates Vehicle Gate website is another reliable platform. Utilize the EVG website to check your traffic fines. Here’s how you can do it:

  • Create an account on the Emirates Vehicle Gate website.
  • Log in and enter the plate number, ticket code, or license number of your vehicle to check your pending fines.
  • Make sure to select the correct options to get accurate information.

3. Ministry of Interior UAE Website

The Ministry of Interior also enables you to check traffic fines for Sharjah vehicles. To access this service:

  • Visit the MOI website and register for an account if you haven’t already.
  • After registration, navigate to the Traffic Services section and enter your traffic file number to check any unpaid fines.

4. RTA Website (Dubai-based)

Although primarily serving Dubai, the RTA website also offers the option of checking Sharjah traffic fines. Just:

  • Click the Traffic Fine tab on the RTA site.
  • Enter your traffic file number to see any fines related to Sharjah.

How to Pay Sharjah Traffic Fines Online

Once your fine appears, you can pay it instantly through

Platform Payment Method
Sharjah Police Portal Debit / Credit Card
Emirates Vehicle Gate (EVG) Debit / Credit Card
Ministry of Interior (MOI) Online payment
Sharjah Police App Mobile payment
Sahl kiosks Card payment

Convenient Payment Methods for Sharjah Traffic Fines

Clear them on time once you’ve checked your traffic fines. This avoids extra charges or penalties. Thankfully, Sharjah has introduced several online methods. The payment of traffic fines is now easier. It brings more convenience than ever for drivers to settle their dues.

The best ways to pay your traffic fines are below:

1. Sharjah Police Online Portal

The Sharjah Police website provides a straightforward way to pay your fines online. Once you’ve checked your fines, you can:

  • Navigate to the payment section.
  • Select your fine and proceed to payment.
  • Use your credit/debit card to make an instant payment.

2. Emirates Vehicle Gate (EVG) Portal

EVG’s website also allows for easy payment:

  • After checking your fines, select the payment option.
  • Choose your preferred payment method, including credit/debit cards.
  • Complete the payment and receive a confirmation receipt.

3. Ministry of Interior Website

On the MOI website, you can follow the same steps:

  • Log in to your account, check your fines, and proceed to pay via credit/debit cards.
  • Payments made through the MOI website are securely processed, ensuring your transaction is hassle-free.

4. Sahl Devices

Sahl devices are available at various locations, providing another way to pay your fines. You simply need to:

  • Locate a nearby Sahl payment kiosk.
  • Enter your vehicle details or traffic fine information.
  • Make the payment via card, and you’ll receive an instant receipt.

5. Sharjah Traffic Fines Mobile App

Sharjah Police also offers a mobile app. It allows you to check and pay fines directly from your smartphone. This is handy for on-the-go payments. An easy-to-use way to clear fines while commuting.

How to Get Traffic Fine Discounts in Sharjah

Sharjah Police offers drivers an incentive. They can clear their traffic fines early through discounts. Save a significant amount on your fines if you act quickly. The discount structure works as follows:

  • 35% Discount: Available for fines cleared within 60 days of registration.
  • 25% Discount: Available for fines paid between 60 days and one year from registration.

This policy aims to encourage responsible driving and prompt payments. This reduces the number of overdue fines.

Types of Traffic Violations in Sharjah and Their Fines

Understanding the different Sharjah traffic violation types is essential. Knowing the penalties associated is also crucial for all drivers. A quick rundown of the main types of violations includes:

1. Serious Traffic Violations

  • Examples: Drunk driving, running red lights, reckless driving.
  • Penalties: Heavy fines and black points. Including vehicle impoundment and license suspension.

2. Speeding Violations

  • Example: Exceeding the speed limit by a certain threshold.
  • Penalties: Fines based on the severity of the violation, with black points and possible vehicle confiscation.

3. Parking Violations

  • Example: Parking in no-parking zones or blocking driveways.
  • Penalties: Fines based on the type of violation and possible vehicle towing.

4. Pedestrian Violations

  • Example: Not yielding to pedestrians at crosswalks.
  • Penalties: Fines, black points, and suspension.

5. Car Modification Violations

  • Example: Modifying vehicles in a way that violates traffic laws.
  • Penalties: Vehicle fines and potential impoundment.

Sharjah Traffic Fine List & Black Points

Here are some of the most common traffic fines in Sharjah:

Violation Fine (AED) Black Points Impound
Speeding up to 20 km/h 300 0 No
Speeding 20–40 km/h 600 4 No
Speeding 40–60 km/h 1,000 6 30 days
Jumping a red signal 1,000 12 30 days
Using a phone while driving 800 4 No
Driving without a license 500 4 7 days
Reckless driving 2,000 23 60 days
Illegal car modification 10,000 12 30 days

What to Do If You Want to Contest a Traffic Fine in Sharjah?

You can contest it if you believe you received an unfair fine. Sharjah provides several avenues for filing complaints:

  • Visit the General Directorate of Traffic headquarters. Go there and file a formal complaint.
  • Call the complaint hotline at +971-4-606-3555.
  •  To support your case, you can also submit proof online or in person.

Before proceeding, be sure to gather all necessary evidence. These include photos or witness statements.

Wrapping Up!

UAE traffic safety is taken seriously. Those keeping track of traffic fines can avoid additional penalties. The authorities made it easier than before. Now, numerous online tools are available. Checking and paying your fines has become an instant process. Utilize the Sharjah Police website, the Emirates Vehicle Gate, or the Ministry of Interior; it’s up to the user which method he/she will use. Stay on top of fines with minimal effort!

Contribute to making Sharjah’s roads safer for everyone. Do so by paying your fines promptly and following the road safety rules.

FAQs: Sharjah Traffic Fines

Q1. What are common traffic violations in Sharjah?

Speeding, using a mobile while driving, and signal jumping.

Q2. How can I check if I have a traffic fine in Sharjah?

Online through the Sharjah Police website or app.

Q3. What payment options exist for Sharjah traffic fines?

You can pay online, at police stations, or at smart kiosks.

Q4. What are the penalties for major violations in Sharjah?

Heavy fines, black points, and sometimes license suspension.

Q5. Can traffic fines affect my car rental deposit?

Yes, rental agencies deduct fines from your deposit.

Q6. Is there a way to avoid fines (traffic rules, speed limits, signage awareness)?

Follow road rules, respect speed limits, and watch road signs.
